decisions.reason: Selecting the default Mailreach package without spam-test credits does not change the registered domain, registrar, or domain-registration requirement.
The Mailreach package selection does not change the campaign domain's web-forwarding destination or behavior.
Excluding Mailreach spam-test credits does not alter the requirement for a campaign mailbox compatible with Gmail.
The Mailreach purchase choice is unrelated to the Zapier Pro subscription and its add-on configuration.
The warm-up tool package selection does not modify the deferred MeetAlfred automated email campaign.
The Mailreach package and spam-test-credit decision does not affect the automated LinkedIn campaign.
The domain warm-up package choice does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred lead synchronization requirement.
Mailreach's default package selection is independent of the MeetAlfred Pro subscription and integration configuration.
Excluding spam-test credits from the warm-up purchase does not alter the silent-lead follow-up workflow.
Spam-test credits are a Mailreach package option and do not change the restrictions on using production leads or identities for integration testing.
The Mailreach package choice does not affect preservation of existing MeetAlfred integrations or campaigns.
The decision not to purchase Mailreach spam-test credits does not change visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
